pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuìhòu yícì xiàlóu , háishì huítóu kàn le kàn chuāngzǐ .
pairs.english: Going downstairs for the last time, Tavi still looked back at the window.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维最后一次下楼，还是回头看了看窗子。

pairs.target: wūlǐ de yīshéng kōng le , chuáng jiǎo què xiàng hái yā zhe zuótiān méi zhé hǎo de xiùzǐ .
pairs.english: The clothesline was empty, yet the bed corner seemed still to hold yesterday's unfolded sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 屋里的衣绳空了，床角却像还压着昨天没折好的袖子。

pairs.target: tā zhīdào dōngxī dōu shōu le , zhēn bāo , zhéchǐ , liànxí zhǐ gè mō guò liǎngbiàn , míngmíng bùgāi yǒu shénme wàng xià , jiǎo dào lóutīkǒu réng tíng le yíxià .
pairs.english: He knew everything was packed, needle packet, ruler and practice papers checked twice each; nothing should be forgotten, yet he paused at the stairs.
pairs.hanzi: 他知道东西都收了，针包、折尺、练习纸各摸过两遍，明明不该有什么忘下，脚到楼梯口仍停了一下。

pairs.target: yù hé cóng hòuyuàn jìnlái , jiāng yìzhāng zhǐ sāi gěi tā , shì tā zuórì ná qù wèn māo huà yǒuméiyǒu hùn zài gōngshì lǐ de nà zhāng .
pairs.english: Yuhe came from the rear yard and handed him the cat drawing from yesterday's joke about official papers.
pairs.hanzi: 郁禾从后院进来，将一张纸塞给他，是他昨日拿去问猫画有没有混在公事里的那张。

pairs.target: tā zhēn gěi tā liúzài zhuōxià le , fāngcái sǎochū bàngè ěrduo , jiào tā xiàcì bié huà dé zhème xiǎo , bùrán chàdiǎn sǎojìn huī duī .
pairs.english: He really had left it under the table. She had just swept out half an ear: next time draw it larger, or it would nearly end up in the dust pile.
pairs.hanzi: 她真给他留在桌下了，方才扫出半个耳朵，叫他下次别画得这么小，不然差点扫进灰堆。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhǎnkāi , māo dùzǐ lǐ què duō le jǐzhī huājiāo , xiàng chī chēng hòu zhèng děng rén lái jiù .
pairs.english: Tavi opened it: peppercorns now filled the cat's belly, as though it had overeaten and awaited rescue.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维展开，猫肚子里却多了几只花椒，像吃撑后正等人来救。

pairs.target: tā táitóu yàoshuō , yù hé yǐjīng zhuǎnshēn qù zhǎo níng qí , gé zhe yuànzi hǎn xīn jiàzi nàbiān hái shǎo yíduàn shéng .
pairs.english: He looked up to speak, but Yuhe was already turning to Ningqi, calling across the yard for another length of rope at the new stand.
pairs.hanzi: 他抬头要说，郁禾已经转身去找宁岐，隔着院子喊新架子那边还少一段绳。

pairs.target: méiyǒu rén yīnwèi tā yào zǒu jiù tíngxià jīnrì de shì .
pairs.english: Nobody stopped today's work because he was leaving.
pairs.hanzi: 没有人因为他要走就停下今日的事。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng huàjiá hǎo , dào ménkǒu , luó dí shēnshǒu zài tā bāo shàng pāi yíxià , shuō zhèhuí bié zhuīchē , shéng zhēn sōng le jiù hǎn chēfū tíng .
pairs.english: Tavi packed the picture. At the door Luodi patted his bundle: no chasing carts this time, call the driver to stop if a rope came loose.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将画夹好，到门口，罗荻伸手在他包上拍一下，说这回别追车，绳真松了就喊车夫停。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng méi zài pángbiān děng tā dàobié , zhèngzài chē hòu tóng rén huàn yìzhī fàng shībù de tǒng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng was not waiting for farewells, but replacing a damp-cloth bucket behind the cart with someone.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡没在旁边等他道别，正在车后同人换一只放湿布的桶。

pairs.target: chēfū jiàn tǎ wéi guòlái , zhǐ gěi tā zuòwèi , shuō lǐtou fēng xiǎo , wàitou hǎokàn , ràng tā zìjǐ xuǎn , xuǎn le bié guò bànchéng yòu tóng mùxiāng huàn .
pairs.english: The driver showed Tavi a seat: inside was sheltered, outside had the view. Choose, but no trading with a crate halfway through.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫见塔维过来，指给他座位，说里头风小，外头好看，让他自己选，选了别过半程又同木箱换。

pairs.target: tā zhèhuí zuò dào wàibiān , xiān bǎ bāo dài lǐ píng .
pairs.english: This time he chose outside and straightened his straps first.
pairs.hanzi: 他这回坐到外边，先把包带理平。

pairs.target: chē guò jiēkǒu , kàn lù nǚrén yǐjīng jǔ zhe duǎn mùpái , shēnhòu liǎngliàngchē zài děng , záhuòpù de mén kāi dé bǐ zuórì dà yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: At the junction the passage woman already held her sign, two carts waiting behind, the general store door a little wider open than yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 车过街口，看路女人已经举着短木牌，身后两辆车在等，杂货铺的门开得比昨日大一点。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi shù , shǒuzhǐ dā zài zìjǐ de bāo shéng shàng , kàn nà dào guǎijiǎo mànmàn tuì dào wūyán hòu .
pairs.english: Tavi did not count, resting his fingers on his bundle cord and watching the corner slowly retreat behind the eaves.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没数，手指搭在自己的包绳上，看那道拐角慢慢退到屋檐后。

pairs.target: zǒushàng zhèn wài de pō , jiù hú yòu xiǎnchū quánxíng , xiàng chū láishí nàyàng héng zài gǔ shàng .
pairs.english: Climbing outside town, they saw the arch's full outline again, spanning the valley as on arrival.
pairs.hanzi: 走上镇外的坡，旧弧又显出全形，像初来时那样横在谷上。

pairs.target: tā kànguò nàme duō zhāng júbù tú , yǎnxià yuǎnyuǎn kàn qù , réng shuōbùchū zhěngjià jiūjìng zěnyàng yòng ;
pairs.english: Despite all the detail drawings, from a distance he still could not explain how the whole structure worked.
pairs.hanzi: 他看过那么多张局部图，眼下远远看去，仍说不出整架究竟怎样用；

pairs.target: tā méi yīnwèi zìjǐ dǒng le yìdiǎn , jiù biànchéng yíjiàn qīngqiǎo de dōngxī , sāijìn zhǐtǒng gēnzhe zǒu .
pairs.english: His small understanding had not made it something light to tuck into a paper tube and carry away.
pairs.hanzi: 它没因为自己懂了一点，就变成一件轻巧的东西，塞进纸筒跟着走。

pairs.target: chēfū wèn ruǎn héng shàngtóu huò lù shìbushì kuài kāi le , shuō zìjǐ tīngshuō xīn jià gōng dōu dào le .
pairs.english: The driver asked Ruan Heng if the upper freight route would open soon; he had heard the new riggers were there.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫问阮衡上头货路是不是快开了，说自己听说新架工都到了。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng shuō dào de shì chá zhīzuò de rén , kāi bu kāi , nǎ yíduàn kāi , hái méiyǒu dìng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng said they were inspecting supports; whether anything opened, and which stretch, remained undecided.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡说到的是查支座的人，开不开、哪一段开，还没有定。

pairs.target: chēfū zā le xià zuǐ , shuō lù yì yuǎn , xiāoxī dǎo bǐ rén xiān guǎiwān . shuōwán yáng le yáng jiāng , jiào qiántou mànzǒu de tuó shòu wǎng biānshàng kào .
pairs.english: The driver clicked his tongue: news turned corners ahead of people on long roads. He flicked the reins and called a slow pack animal ahead to the side.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫咂了下嘴，说路一远，消息倒比人先拐弯。说完扬了扬缰，叫前头慢走的驮兽往边上靠。

pairs.target: wǔqián zài lùbiān huànshuǐ shí , tóng chē yíwèi mǔqīn bào zhe háizi xiàchē .
pairs.english: During a roadside water change before noon, a mother traveling with them carried her child down.
pairs.hanzi: 午前在路边换水时，同车一位母亲抱着孩子下车。

pairs.target: háizi gāngxǐng , kū zhe búyào zài zuò mùxiāng páng , shuō nà kuài dīngtóu lǎo gōu zìjǐ de qún . tǎ wéi dūnxià kàn , guǒrán yǒu yì jié xìshéng guà zài tūchū de dīng biān , qúnbǎi yǐjīng lā chū yídào bái yìn .
pairs.english: Just awake, the child cried against sitting by the crate: a nail kept snagging her skirt. Tavi crouched and found a thin cord caught by the protruding nail, a white pulled line already marking the hem.
pairs.hanzi: 孩子刚醒，哭着不要再坐木箱旁，说那块钉头老勾自己的裙。塔维蹲下看，果然有一截细绳挂在突出的钉边，裙摆已经拉出一道白印。

pairs.target: chēfū ná bùbāo zhù dīngtóu , tā wèn néng bunéng zài yòng shéng yāzhù , miǎnde bù fānkāi .
pairs.english: The driver wrapped the nail in cloth. Tavi asked to tie it down too, keeping the cloth from turning back.
pairs.hanzi: 车夫拿布包住钉头，他问能不能再用绳压住，免得布翻开。

pairs.target: mǔqīn diǎntóu , tā cái qǔchū luó dí gěi de duǎnshéng , ràoguò xiāng jiǎo , dǎlegè néng sōngkāi de jié .
pairs.english: The mother nodded, and he used Luodi's short rope around the crate corner, making a releasable knot.
pairs.hanzi: 母亲点头，他才取出罗荻给的短绳，绕过箱角，打了个能松开的结。

pairs.target: dìyīcì duǎn tóu liú dé tàiduǎn , tā zìjǐ jiěkāi chóng lái , méiyǒu děng shuí pāi tā shǒubèi .
pairs.english: He left the short end too short first, undid it himself and tried again, without waiting for anyone to slap his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 第一次短头留得太短，他自己解开重来，没有等谁拍他手背。

pairs.target: háizi dīng zhe kàn , děng tā zhā wán , shēn zhǐ qīngqīng chuō yíxià , shuō xiàng yǒu liǎngzhī ěrduo .
pairs.english: The child watched, then gently poked the finished knot and said it had two ears.
pairs.hanzi: 孩子盯着看，等他扎完，伸指轻轻戳一下，说像有两只耳朵。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèng xiǎng shuō búshì ěrduo , xiǎngdào bāo lǐ de māo , biàn wèn tā xiàngbuxiàng māo .
pairs.english: Tavi nearly said they were not ears, remembered his packed cat drawing, and asked whether it looked like a cat.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维正想说不是耳朵，想到包里的猫，便问她像不像猫。

pairs.target: háizi yáotóu , shuō xiàng tùzi , zhuǎntóu biàn bùkěn zài kàn tā , qù zhuī mǔqīn wǎn lǐ de rèshuǐ .
pairs.english: The child shook her head: a rabbit. Then she ignored him and went after her mother's hot water.
pairs.hanzi: 孩子摇头，说像兔子，转头便不肯再看他，去追母亲碗里的热水。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng zuòzài shí biān , náchū gěi nǚér dài de liǎngtiáo bùdài , xuǎn le bàntiān yòu dōu shōuhuí .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng sat by a rock, brought out two ribbons for his daughter, considered them a long time, then put both away.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡坐在石边，拿出给女儿带的两条布带，选了半天又都收回。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn búshì yìtiáo jiù gòu , duìfāng shuō shàng huí zìjǐ tiāo de yánsè bú duì , zhèhuí dǎsuàn jiào tā zìjǐ xuǎn , shèng yìtiáo hái néng liúgěi pángrén , miǎnde yòu jiāng tiāo xié de yuēdìng tuō dào xià tàng huílái .
pairs.english: Tavi asked if one was not enough. Ruan Heng said he had picked the wrong color last time; now she could choose, the other kept for someone else. He must not postpone their shoe-shopping promise until another return.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问不是一条就够，对方说上回自己挑的颜色不对，这回打算叫她自己选，剩一条还能留给旁人，免得又将挑鞋的约定拖到下趟回来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dìyīcì xiǎngdào , ruǎn héng huíchéng yě yǒurén pàn tā xiān bié fān gōngzuò zhǐ .
pairs.english: For the first time Tavi thought someone in the city also hoped Ruan Heng would leave his work papers alone for a while.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维第一次想到，阮衡回城也有人盼他先别翻工作纸。

pairs.target: tā méi wèn nà xié dàodǐ yào huā duōshǎo , zhī bǎ zìjǐ bāo lǐ de zhēn bāo yā dào búhuì zhé de wèizhì , qǐshēn tì chēfū bǎ kōng shuǐtǒng sòng guòqù .
pairs.english: He did not ask the shoes' cost, only secured his needle packet against bending, then carried the empty water bucket to the driver.
pairs.hanzi: 他没问那鞋到底要花多少，只把自己包里的针包压到不会折的位置，起身替车夫把空水桶送过去。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn dào le xiējiǎo kèzhàn , háishì nà zhāng chángzhuō , zhuōbiān duō le yìzhī quēkǒu bēi .
pairs.english: At the waystation inn that evening, the long table remained, with one extra chipped cup.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚到了歇脚客栈，还是那张长桌，桌边多了一只缺口杯。

pairs.target: shàng huí luó dí zuò de dìfāng rújīn zuò zhe mài zhǒngzi de nánrén , tán jiàqián de shēngyīn dà dé xiàng yào bǎ zhǒngzi yílì lì hǎnchūlái . tǎ wéi jiāng bāofàng hǎo , méi tèyì liúchū pángbiān de wèizhì .
pairs.english: A seed seller occupied Luodi's old place, bargaining so loudly he seemed to call each seed out separately. Tavi settled his bundle without reserving the place beside him.
pairs.hanzi: 上回罗荻坐的地方如今坐着卖种子的男人，谈价钱的声音大得像要把种子一粒粒喊出来。塔维将包放好，没特意留出旁边的位置。

pairs.target: shuì qián tā qù kàn xiāng jiǎo de bù , mǔqīn yǐjīng jiěkāi shéng shōu hǎo , shuō cìrì huàn gè zuò fǎ , búhuì zài pèng , ràng tā bǎ shéngdài huíqù .
pairs.english: Before bed he checked the crate cloth. The mother had put the rope away: they would sit differently tomorrow and avoid it, so he could take his rope back.
pairs.hanzi: 睡前他去看箱角的布，母亲已经解开绳收好，说次日换个坐法，不会再碰，让他把绳带回去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò , zhǐjiān wén zhe yìdiǎn gāncǎo wèi , huí fáng jiāng tā fàngzài xīn chǐ páng .
pairs.english: Tavi took it, a hint of dry grass on his fingers, and laid it beside the new ruler in his room.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过，指尖闻着一点干草味，回房将它放在新尺旁。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng yǐ shuì dé hěnchén , tā chuī xīdēng , hēiàn lǐ què hái xiàng tīngjiàn zhé tóng nà zhèn chuānguò jiù hú de fēng .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng was deeply asleep. Tavi blew out the lamp, yet in darkness still seemed to hear Zhetong's wind through the arch.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡已睡得很沉，他吹熄灯，黑暗里却还像听见折桐那阵穿过旧弧的风。
